# BMI calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/bmi/

Calculate adult body mass index from weight in kilograms and height in centimeters. The result uses weight divided by squared height in meters.

## How to use it

1. Enter the numbers, dates or units you want to compare.
2. Choose the calculation options and calculate.
3. Review the result together with the assumptions shown.

## Example

Enter 65 kg and 170 cm to get an adult BMI of approximately 22.5.

## Limits and checks

BMI is a screening calculation, not a diagnosis. It does not account for pregnancy, body composition or individual health.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
